headline: Pakistan and China Agree on Government-to-Government Fuel Storage and LPG Deals
summary: Pakistan and China agreed to pursue government-to-government arrangements for Chinese investment in Pakistani petrol and liquefied petroleum gas storage and terminal facilities.
why: Bilateral energy infrastructure investments help secure domestic fuel supplies and improve energy logistics in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Pakistan
impacts.why: Foreign direct investment in energy storage infrastructure expands national storage capacity.
